Commentary.Commentary: Right then, the Australian players join Aaron Finch to lift the trophy and celebrate a thumping series win. The skipper will be lifting an ODI Trophy for the last time and he will be quite emotional. The players pose for a team photo and that brings an end to a pretty one-sided series. The Kiwis will now play a T20I tri-series at home against Pakistan and Bangladesh with their first game on 8th October (Saturday) at 11.30 am IST (6 am GMT) against Pakistan. Australia will travel to India for a three-match T20I series with the first game on 20th September (Tuesday) at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT). The cricketing action continues though as Pakistan take on Sri Lanka in the Asia Cup final. Kindly switch tabs and follow the build-up to an exciting game. From our side, it is goodbye and cheers!

Aaron Finch the skipper of Australia says that the partnership between Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne was brilliant and to get to over 260 after the slow start was good to see. Mentions that his family has sacrificed a lot for him and he will always be grateful for that. Adds that they go to Sydney for a photo shoot and then travel to India for their series on Thursday therefore not much of a turnaround for them. Informs that there are so many people to thank starting from his club to everyone who supported him throughout his career. He mentions that he is grateful to his wife and kids who always stood by his side in ups and downs.

Kane Williamson the captain of New Zealand says that they put up an improved performance but credits Australia for the quality they have shown through the series. Adds that there were some moments throughout the series where they were on top but Australia were able to reverse it every time and they have a lot to learn from their quality opposition. Mentions that they need to adapt to conditions quickly and put pressure on teams whenever they have the opportunity. Ends by praising Aaron Finch for his outstanding ODI career and for being a wonderful contributor to the game.

Steven Smith has been adjudged Player of the Match as well as the Player of the Series for his outstanding batting effort throughout the series. He says that his main goal is to contribute to the success of the team. Adds that it is difficult to open the innings while batting with the way the Kiwi opening bowlers are playing. Mentions that he loves batting at number 3 but he will do whatever his team requires. Ends by saying that Aaron Finch has been great for Australian cricket for over 10 years and everyone is sad to see him go.
Time for the presentation...

New Zealand began the game well putting pressure on the opponents right from the word go. They, unfortunately, came across the stubborn duo of Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne who put on a 100-run plus partnership to get Australia to safety. Steven Smith scored a brilliant century to continue his good run in the series. Alex Carey and Cameron Green finished well to get their team to a good total. Trent Boult bowled really well and was economical through his spell taking a couple of wickets. The rest of the bowlers were a touch too expensive and in the end, the total proved to be out of reach despite the fight shown by some of the batters. They all got to double figures but none of them were able to reach half-centuries.

Australia did not start well with the ball bowling far too many loose deliveries but once they got the openers dismissed, they managed to gain control of the game. Sean Abbott and Cameron Green were the ones to take the wickets after the opening bowlers failed to make an impact and they kept bowling with discipline. Adam Zampa and Josh Hazlewood took a wicket each in the middle overs and a silly run out of the Kiwi captain had them right on top in the game. The visitors, however, were able to put on a couple of 50-run partnerships to take the game to the death. Mitchell Starc who had not performed well until then came back to bowl a lovely over dismissing Glenn Phillips and Sean Abbott took the wicket of Mitchell Santner. After that, it was just an exhibition of dot balls as they were able to defend the target with relative ease. Mitchell Starc wiped the tail out and ended with three wickets while Sean Abbott and Cameron Green took two each.

New Zealand got off to a positive start putting on a 49-run partnership for the opening wicket but both the openers departed after getting off to decent starts. Kane Williamson continued to struggle as he played in a labored manner in an attempt to build an inning. When he departed, the Kiwis had lost five wickets for the score of 112 on the board. James Neesham and Glenn Phillips got together and put on a 61-run partnership in just 58 balls to get a bit of momentum on their side. The former was dismissed on 36 after which Mitchell Santner joined forces with Glenn Phillips to take the game deep. They needed 46 runs in the last 30 balls which looked quite achievable. Glenn Phillips departed three runs short of his half-century and when Mitchell Santner followed soon after all hopes of a win were crushed. The visitors put on a better performance this time with the bat but have still fallen short.

Australia have bowled out their opponents and handed their outgoing captain a comprehensive series win! This game looked like it will go to the wire but in the end, the hosts have cantered to a comfortable 25-run win over their helpless opponents. They have white-washed the series and New Zealand will have to wait for an elusive win against the Aussies in their backyard. This game was closely contested all through, up until the last four overs when things just fell apart for the Kiwis. They will have to rework their plans with the T20 World Cup right around the corner.

OUT! TAKEN! That is that for the New Zealand innings and Aaron Finch ends his ODI career with a great win. Mitchell Starc serves a full delivery and outside off, Trent Boult makes room to hit it, but slices it up in the air and towards deep extra cover. Marnus Labuschagne runs towards it from the deep and pouches it safely while sliding in. AUSTRALIA WIN THE MATCH BY 25 RUNS AND COMPLETE THE WHITEWASH AS THEY TAKE THE SERIES 3-0. The players from both the sides congratulate Aaron Finch on his brilliant ODI career.
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TIMBER! Mitchell Starc fires in a yorker, on middle, angling in, Lockie Ferguson moves across to work it to the leg side, but misses his flick and the ball sneaks through between his legs to crash onto the stumps. Australia one wicket away from victory now.
Starc pitches it up and on middle, Lockie Ferguson tucks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Another full delivery, on off, Tim Southee drills it towards long off again for a run.
Full and on off, Tim Southee mistimes his lofted shot towards long off for a brace.
Mitchell Starc to bowl the last over.
Another short ball, but slower this time on middle, Lockie Ferguson is through his pull shot early and misses to catch the ball on elbows. 31 runs needed in 6 balls.
Short and on middle, Tim Southee pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Too little too late now. This is full and on middle, Tim Southee lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Another dot as Tim Southee gives charge to slog it away but fails to pick the slower one and misses again.
Short and on middle, Lockie Ferguson pull it towards deep square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, keeps low, Lockie Ferguson looks to heave it away but misses.
Finally a single as this full delivery is tucked away towards deep mid-wicket.
Another knuckle ball and outside off, Lockie Ferguson swings and misses again.
A knuckle ball now, on a length and outside off, Lockie Ferguson fails to pick it and plays all over it. Another dot!
This is the eighth dot ball in a row. Hazlwood bowls this on a length and outside off, Lockie Ferguson gets beaten again.
A slower short ball, on middle, Lockie Ferguson pulls it towards shor fine leg but no run is taken. Poor cricket from the Kiwis.
Josh Hazlewood comes into the attack and bowls a good-length delivery, on off, Lockie Ferguson tries o slog it away but only connects with thin air.
Tim Southee is just not seeing the ball right now. This is slower again, full and around off, Tim Southee throws his bat at it but plays all over it.
Another slower bouncer, on off, Tim Southee leaves it in the hope of getting a wide, but the umpires signals nothing.
Swing and a miss! This is on a good length and on middle, Tim Southee swings wildly at it but cannot connect.
This is a slower ball, on a length and outside off, Tim Southee reaches out for it but gets nowhere near it and misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sean Abbott gets the wicket of Mitchell Santner and it seems like New Zealand's last hope is making its way back to the pavilion. Sean Abbott bowls this full and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes to loft this over long off but does not get the best connection. The ball sails into the hands of Cameron Green at long off and the Australian players celebrate. Sean Abbott is proving himself as a death bowler as well in this series.
Commentary.Howout: c Cameron Green b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: Lockie Ferguson comes out to the middle.
WIDE! Sean Abbott bangs this in short and outside off, Mitchell Santner leaps up to upper cut this but misses. The ball goes over the head and is called wide by the umpire.
Sean Abbott bowls this on a good length and outside off, Mitchell Santner looks to swing but misses.
Bowls a full toss on the pads, Mitchell Santner clips this towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Mitchell Santner is still at the crease though! Mitchell Starc strays on the pads on a fuller length, Mitchell Santner clips this fine and just manages to beat the diving keeper down leg side. The ball runs away to fine leg off the pads for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! A great catch under pressure in the deep and this could prove to be the turning point of the game as Glenn Phillips goes back to the hut. Mitchell Starc serves this full and on leg, Glenn Phillips stays there and slogs it. However, he fails to get under the ball and hits it high up in the air towards deep square leg. Sean Abbott there judges it well to pouch it safely, but as he took it he realises that he is going over the ropes and relaeses the ball in the air to take it back inside the ropes. The umpires are not sure and sends it upstairs to check. Teh replays shows that Abbott did well to release the ball just in time when he went over the ropes and took it cleanly afterwards. Everyone is glued to the big screen as this is a huge moment in the game, and the Australians are delighted as OUT is displayed on the screen.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Abbott b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Another brilliant yorker, outside off this time, Glenn Phillips is late to put his bat down and misses.
A good yorker, on middle, Glenn Phillips still manages to squeez it out towards long on where a fumble allows the batters a second run.
A low full toss and on off, Glenn Phillips drills it straight back to the bowler where Starc does really well to field it.
Mitchell Starc (8-0-52-0) is back on.
A slower bouncer, on leg, Glenn Phillips waits for it and pulls it towards fine leg for one more.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Mitchell Santner goes back and slaps it down to long on for another run.
Full and on the pads, Glenn Phillips flicks it towards deep square leg for single.
Another slower ball, on length and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes for the heave. but adjusts well to push it towards cover for one.
WIDE! Abbott bangs in a slower bouncer, on middle, Mitchell Santner goes for the ramp shot but misses. It is called a wide as it went above the batter's head.
A good-length delivery, on middle, Glenn Phillips forces it towards long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Mitchell Santner drives it towards extra cover for a single.
Change.

BEAUTY! This is flighted, full and on off, turning away, Glenn Phillips looks to drive it it but gets beaten on the outside edge due to the turn. Alex Carey collects and takes the bails off to appeal for the stumping. The umpire sends it upstairs to see, the replay shows that there is clear gap between bat and ball, and his foot is on the crease when the stumps were broken. The decision remains Not Out.
A leg spinner, short and on middle, turning in, Mitchell Santner stays back and pushes it towards point for one.
Fires this full and down the leg, Mitchell Santner tucks it away but straight to short fine leg.
Zampa lands this short and outside off, Glenn Phillips cuts it off his back foot towards point for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Mitchell Santner drives it towards long off for a run.
FOUR! Good shot from Santner. This is a half-volley, on middle, Mitchell Santner stays in his crease and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Zampa will be under pressure now.
A slower short delivery, on leg, Mitchell Santner mistimes his pull shot towards short fine leg for a single. A good over for the Kiwis, but they need a couple more of these.
Starc fires in a yorker, on off, Glenn Phillips digs it out towards long off for a run.
On a hard length and outside off, Mitchell Santner punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Massive blow! Starc pitches it up, on middle, in the slot as well, Mitchell Santner backs his abilities and slogs it towards the deep mid-wicket fence, he has done enough to clear the fence.
This is on a good length and on middle, Mitchell Santner looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge back to Starc.
Mitchell Starc comes into the attack and serves a full delivery, on the leg stump line, Glenn Phillips flicks it uppishly towards deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle, Glenn Phillips wristily flicks it towards long on for one. 70 runs needed in 48 balls now.
Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and outside off, shaping away a bit, Glenn Phillips punches it off his back foot towards covers.
Almost on a yorker length and on middle, Mitchell Santner squeezes it towards long off for another run.
Another single as this full delivery is drilled down to long on.
A slower one, full and on middle, Mitchell Santner waits for it and works it towards long on for a single.

This is on a good length and outside off, angling away, Mitchell Santner looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. Oh...well! The snicko shows that there was some bat involved, but nobody appealed and Santner survives. Will this prove to be the turning point?
Flighted up and around middle, Mitchell Santner pushes this back to the bowler where Zampa misfields and allows a run.
Darted in a yorker, on middle, Mitchell Santner steps out and digs it out.
Short again and on middle, Glenn Phillips slaps it down to long on for a single.
SIX! BANG! This is short and outside off, Glenn Phillips clears his front leg and smashes it over the deep extra cover fence for a biggie. They need some more these.
Full again and on middle, Glenn Phillips knocks it towards mid-wicket.
The onus will lie on Glenn Phillips if New Zealand are to achieve this target. It is not an impossible proposition as long as they are able to take this game deep.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Mitchell Santner drives it towards long off.

This is on a good length but pitching on leg, Mitchell Santner tucks this towards deep square leg for a single. That brings an end to Powerplay 2. Australia can now place the fifth payer on the boundary line. New Zealand need 83 runs from 60 balls.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Mitchell Santner clips this towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Where did that come from? Mitchell Santner kept blocking and suddenly launched into a shot. Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and offers a bit of width, Mitchell Santner gets into the shot in a jiffy and pulls aerially towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Goes straight in line with the stumps on a good length, Mitchell Santner gets squared up as he taps this towards covers.
On a good length once again and in the outside off stump channel. Glenn Phillips blocks this towards mid on and takes off for a quick single.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and outside off, Mitchell Santner times this sweetly past point but they get just a single.
Change of ends for Josh Hazlewood.
Bowls a quicker delivery, short and angled into the batter, Glenn Phillips uses the depth of the crease and blocks the ball back to the bowler.
This is flighted full and outside off, Mitchell Santner strokes this to long off and takes a single.
Another googly served short and outside off, Mitchell Santner rocks back and looks to cut but gets beaten.
WIDE! Strays down leg side on a fuller length. The umpire calls this wide.
Bowls a googly full and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes for a shot but misses.
Floats this one full and in line with the stump. The ball skids on and Mitchell Santner just about manages to keep this out.
Adam Zampa begins with a short delivery outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Aaron Finch brings back Adam Zampa (7-0-34-1) into the attack.
Bangs this in short and in line with the stumps. Mitchell Santner stands in the crease and sways out of the way.
Goes back of a length this time and just outside off, Mitchell Santner fends this towards backward point.
Bowls a slower delivery full and outside the off pole. Glenn Phillips strokes this towards mid off and takes a single as the fielder is on the edge of the circle.
This is on a good length and outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips blocks this towards cover.
Cameron Green serves this one full and one the pads, Mitchell Santner gets his bat down in time and clips the ball to deep square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Mitchell Santner is the next man in for New Zealand.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dangerous James Neesham has holed out in the deep! Australia will know that this was the main wicket. Cameron Green bowls a full delivery just outside off and takes ace off the ball. James Neesham is early into the shot and moans as soon as he plays it. The ball goes high towards long on where Steven Smith takes an easy catch. New Zealand have lost their sixth wicket and their task has gotten a shade tougher.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips pushes at this and gets an inside edge towards the keeper. Alex Carey dives to his left and stops the ball.

FOUR! Finally gets to release the pressure! Josh Hazlewood pulls his length back a fraction and Glenn Phillips is onto it in a flash. He lofts this towards the deep mid-wicket boundary and collects four more runs.
On a good length once again and just outside off, Glenn Phillips can not get this away and plays it back to the bowler.
This is on a good length and 127 kph, the ball nips back into the batter. Glenn Phillips blocks this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this at 134 clicks outside the off stump on a good length, Glenn Phillips is early into his shot and gets beaten.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, James Neesham flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.
Bowls a low full toss just outside off, Glenn Phillips taps this back towards the bowler.
On a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips looks to play a cross-batted shot but gets an inside edge to the left of the keeper. Alex Carey dives and stops the ball.
Pulls his length back a fraction and bowls this outside off, James Neesham gets the best connection but finds the deep mid-wicket fielder this time.
FOUR! This has been spanked sway! Cameron Green bowls this on a length and in line with the stumps, James Neesham hits this well and the ball races away to the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
Goes over the wicket now and bowls this short and outside off, James Neesham pulls this towards deep square leg and takes two runs.
Cameron Green starts from 'round the wicket to the left-hander and bowls this on a good length and outside off, James Neesham blocks this back towards the bowler.
Cameron Green (4-0-16-1) is back on.
Goes back to bowling a yorker on off stump, Glenn Phillips digs this out towards mid off.

FOUR! Power is followed by elegance! This is one a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips guides this between backward point and short third man and picks up four more runs. Glenn Phillips wants to join this party as well.

SIX! This has been powered away! Mitchell Starc bangs this in short and outside off, Glenn Phillips gets on his toes and slaps this over deep cover for a maximum. That is one of the best shots played in this game.
Nails a yorker once again onto the pads, James Neesham flicks this to deep square leg for a singe.

FOUR! This is a lovely shot straight down the ground! Mitchell Starc goes full once again and just outside off, James Neesham lifts this with a straight bat towards long in for a boundary. James Neesham can be really dangerous if he gets going.
Mitchell Starc begins with a yorker aimed for the toes, Glenn Phillips digs it out towards backward square leg and they take a run.
This is full as well and angling into the stumps, Glenn Phillips clips this to the right of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flights this one full and on the pads, James Neesham clips this through square leg for a single.
Fires this one full and wide outside off, James Neesham knocks this straight to point.
Bowls this quick on the pads on a fuller length, James Neesham misses his sweep and the ball hits his pads.
FOUR! This has been delicately played! Adam Zampa bowls a googly full and outside ff, James Neesham reads this well and stays back to play it late towards third man for a boundary.
Adam Zampa fires this one full and well outside off, James Neesham steps across the stumps to heave this towards the leg side but misses.
Full once again and just outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this straight to the cover fielder. Just three runs from this over and the pressure is building.
This is in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips taps this back to the bowlers right.
On a good length and outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips blocks this towards cover.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, James Neesham works this to deep point and take another single.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Glenn Phillips stands tall and punches this to deep point for a single.
Mitchell Starc serves this on a good length but strays onto the pads, James Neesham clips the ball towards mid-wicket and takes a run.

Drinks! Australia are on top of this game at the moment. They are picking up wickets in regular intervals but they have dropped three caught and bowled chances, the latest one being on the last delivery before drinks where Zampa dropped Neesham. New Zealand need a partnership now and cannot afford to lose any more wickets atleast till the 40th over. Australia know that they are just a couple of wickets away from putting the Kiwis under huge pressure. An exciting session awaits us as Mitchell Starc (5-0-23-0) comes into the attack now

Adam Zampa floats this one full and in line with the stumps, James Neesham charges down the wicket and thumps this back towards the bowler. Adam Zampa gets his hands up but does not hold onto the ball. It rolls behind up as they take a single. Another tough caught and bowled opportunity goes begging.

FOUR! James Neesham is still fighting here! Adam Zampa bowls this full and pitching outside leg, James Neesham goes for the reverse sweep once again. This time he gets it to the left of short fine leg and the ball races away to the deep backward point fence.

Adam Zampa flights this one full and outside off, James Neesham charges down the wicket and lifts this high into the sky. He manages to clear Mitchell Starc at mid off and in lands safely as they take two runs.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Glenn Phillips works this to deep point and takes another run.
Goes full once again and pitches outside leg, James Neesham reverse sweeps this to deep point for a single.
Adam Zampa begins with a full delivery in line with the stumps, James Neesham tucks this towards short fine leg.
Adam Zampa (5-0-19-1) comes back into the attack.

Another mistimed heave from James Neesham. Sean Abbott bowls this slightly full and outside off, James Neesham looks to loft this over the leg side but gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a single. He will keep strike.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips works this towards cover and gets across for a run.
This is on a good length as well and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips pulls this towards deep mid-wicket and picks up a brace.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, James Neesham heaves but mistimes it to the left of mid on for a quick single.
Delivers this one a good length and just outside off, James Neesham goes for the pull shot but the ball is not short enough. Plays over the ball as it goes through to the keeper.
Sean Abbott bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump, James Neesham dabs this towards point.
Tossed up, full and on off, James Neesham drives it towards long off for a single.
Darted down the leg side, Glenn Phillips helps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Slows it up, on middle, James Neesham goes for the sweep again, but gets a top edge towards deep mid-wicket. A single is taken.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for the Kiwis. This is tossed up, full and on middle, James Neesham goes down and sweeps it well wide of the deep mid-wicket where Marnus Labuschagne tries to cover his ground to the left, dives in but cannot stop it from going to the fence.
Flighted and on off, turning away, James Neesham goes on his back foot and plays it towards point.
Glenn Maxwell continues from around the wicket and serves this a bit short, on leg, Glenn Phillips flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length and around off, James Neesham knocks it towards point.
This is on a good length and on middle, James Neesham tries to go for the heave towards mid-wicket, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE! Abbott bangs in a bouncer, on middle, James Neesham offers no shot at it. It is called a wide for height.
Fullish delivery and on off, James Neesham blocks it out.
This is on a good length and angling into the pads, Glenn Phillips looks to block and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and they take a single.
Pulls his length back a fraction and serves this outside off, Glenn Phillips guides this towards point.
Sean Abbott begins with a good-length delivery outside off, Glenn Phillips defends this towards mid off.
This one is a fraction short and outside the off stump, James Neesham goes on the back foot and plays this towards point.
Full once again and floated outside off, James Neesham blocks this towards the third man fielder.
Glenn Maxwell flights this one full and outside off, James Neesham taps this towards point.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! RUN OUT! A misunderstanding in the middle and New Zealand skipper has to go back now. This is short and outside off, Glenn Phillips cuts it towards deep point for a single. However, Kane Williamson wants the second and takes a couple of steps down the pitch, Phillips also responds, but he sends Willliamson back mid way through. Marnus Labuschagne from the deep throws in towards the keeper and Alex Carey does the rest as Kane Williamson is in no man's land. A crazy way to lose another wicket and New Zealand have now lost half their side.
Short again and on middle, Kane Williamson goes on his back foot and forces it towards long on for a single.
Short and on middle, Glenn Phillips flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length again, on leg, Kane Williamson takes a couple of steps to work it to the side but misses and the ball loops up off his pads to the off side.
A peach of a delivery! This is on a good length and around off, gets this to nip back in sharply, Kane Williamson gets cut in half as he tries to play at it, and the ball goes just over the off pole.
Abbott continues with the fuller length, on middle this time, Kane Williamson flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish one, on off, Kane Williamson comes down the track only to knock it back to the bowler.
This is on a good length and around off, Kane Williamson opens the face of his bat and guides it straight to point.
Full delivery, on middle, Kane Williamson blocks it with full face towards mid on.
Shortish again and on leg, Glenn Phillips pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Goes short this time, on leg, Glenn Phillips knocks it to the right of mid-wicket where Steven Smith puts in a brilliant dive to stop it.
Darted full and down the leg, Kane Williamson flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Shorter again and on leg, Glenn Phillips tucks it towards square leg for a quick single and gets off the mark.
Tossed, up, short and on middle, Glenn Phillips blocks it out from the back foot.
Quicker and flatter, on middle, Kane Williamson moves on his back foot and flicks it through square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips taps the ball towards the point fielder. Josh Hazlewood completes a successful over.
Glenn Phillips walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The partnership has been broken and Daryl Mitchell has to depart! Josh Hazlewood bangs this in short and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for the pull but only gets a top edge that flies high towards cover-point. He does not even look at the ball as he know he is gone here. Steven Smith setteles under this and takes a really easy catch. Everytime New Zealand look like they are getting a move on, a wicket falls and ushes them back again.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: This is back of a length and outside off, Kane Williamson goes back in the crease and punches this to deep cover for a single.
Goes full this time and follows the batter to the leg side as he looks to make room. Kane Williamson hits through the line and chips the ball towards the deep mid-wicket fence for two runs.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and outside off, Kane Williamson dabs this towards backward point.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this slightly short and wide outside off, Kane Williamson cuts this and gets the ball on the bounce over point for a couple of runs.
Flights this one full and pitching outside leg, Kane Williamson goes for a sweep shot but gets a top edge that goes over the short fine leg fielder and they take a single.
Bowls this slower in the air, full and on middle. Daryl Mitchell clips this to the right of mid-wicket and takes off for a run. A better throw at the keeper's end and Kane Williamson was a goner.
Strays on the pads once again on a shorter length, Kane Williamson tucks this towards square leg and gets a run.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson clips this to the right of the bowler and Glenn Maxwell dives to stop this one. Makes it look really easy.
This is angling down leg on a fuller length, Daryl Mitchell clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Glenn Maxwell begins with a loopy delivery full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell taps the ball to the left of the bowler.
Aaron Finch introduces Glenn Maxwell into the attack.
Bowls this back of a length and outside the off stump, Daryl Mitchell plays a good-looking pull towards deep square leg for a single.
This is well outside off on a good length, Kane Williamson guides this to third man for a single.

This is on a good length as well and outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for a heave to the leg side to release some pressure. Gets an inside edge towards the deep mid-wicket boundary and they take three.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole, Daryl Mitchell shimmies across and pushes at the ball but gets beaten all ends up.
Goes a fraction fuller and angles this into the stumps, Daryl Mitchell clips this towards mid-wicket.
Josh Hazlewood begins with a good-length delivery just outside off, Daryl Mitchell blocks this towards mid off.
Shorter in length and on off, Kane Williamson pushes it towards covers with no timing at all.
This is full as well and flighted outside off, Daryl Mitchell hits this to long off and takes a single.
Loopy delivery full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets on the front foot and blocks the ball into the off side.
Bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Kane Williamson goes back in the crease and knocks the ball to long on for a single.
This is floated full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a single.
Flights this one full and outside off, Kane Williamson clips it to long on and takes a run.
This is full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets a strike forwards and defends the ball towards cover.
FOUR! That is a cracking shot! Mitchell Starc bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell strokes this over the bowler's head for a boundary. He holds the pose after the shot.
This is pitching outside leg on a good length, Daryl Mitchell clips this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
This is straight as well and on a fuller length, Daryl Mitchell blocks this back towards the bowler.
Goes full this time and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell digs this out back towards the bowler. Had a chance to grab onto a catch but this is hard and the ball goes to cover.
Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson clips this past square leg for a single.
Looped up and around off, Daryl Mitchell blocks it out.
Flighted, full and on off, truning away, Daryl Mitchell knocks it towards point.
FOUR! Poor from Zampa and rightly punished. This is short and down the leg side, Daryl Mitchell helps it towards the wide fine leg fence for an easy boundary.
Shorter in length and on off, Kane Williamson slaps it to the right of the bowler where Zampa tries to cut it out, but fails to do so as Mitchell's bat came in the way. A single taken.
Flatter and around off, Kane Williamson pushes it towards the left of cover where Finch puts in a dive to save the single.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson defends it off his front foot.
A dot to end the over as Mitchell blocks out this length ball to the leg side. Just one run of the over then.
Starc pitches it up and outside off, Kane Williamson drives it through covers for a single.
Four dots on the trot! This is back of a length and off, Kane Williamson pushes it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Starc serves this back of a length and just outside off, Kane Williamson taps this towards the point fielder.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson clips this to the right of the bowler.
Mitchell Starc comes into the attack and bowls a good length delivery in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson defends this back towards the bowler.
Flights this one full and outside the off stump. Daryl Mitchell gets on his front foot and blocks the ball to the left of the bowler. A successful over from Adam Zampa.
Adam Zampa floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell clips this towards mid-wicket.
Daryl Mitchell makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! A very unlucky way to get out, but Latham has to go back to the hut. Zampa bowls this quicker and flatter, on leg, Tom Latham skips down the track to work it away to the leg side. However, he misses his flick, and the ball goes onto hit his front leg, then hits the back pad and goes towards the keeper. Alex Carey waits for the ball to come to him and then shatters the stumps. They appeal for the stumping, and the umpire sends it upstairs. The replay shows that Latham put in a desperate dive but is still well short of his crease when the stumps were broken. New Zealand three down now.
Commentary.Howout: st Alex Carey b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy delivery, on middle, Kane Williamson takes a couple of steps down the pitch and drives it towards long on for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Kane Williamson leans on and pushes it towards covers.
Floated, full and on middle, Tom Latham paddle sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Kane Williamson drills it straight back to the bowler where Green does well to cut it out.
Shorter in length and on middle, Tom Latham gets on top of the bounce and tucks it away towards mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length and outside off, Tom Latham stays there and taps it towards point.
This is pitched up and on the leg stump line, Kane Williamson flicks it through square leg for a single.
Full again and on off, Kane Williamson drives it straight to mid off.
Green serves this full and on the pads, Tom Latham misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards backward square leg. A leg bye taken.

DRINKS! The players will get some refreshments and reanalyze their plans. New Zealand got off to a really good start but the loss of their two openers means that they will now have to rebuild the innings. Kane Williamson and Tom Latham are looking solid at the middle but have loads of work to do here. Australia have done well to come back after getting off to a poor start and will know it is all about taking wickets. Cameron Green (3-0-13-1) will begin proceedings after the break.
Another dot to end the over as Williamson defends this full ball to the leg side. Only 1 run from the over.
Flighted, full and on middle, Kane Williamson kncoks it back to the bowler.
Floated and around off, Kane Williamson defends it on his front foot.
A bit short and outside off, Kane Williamson goes on his back foot and bunts it onto the ground towards short covers.
Tossed up, full and on off, turning away, Kane Williamson blocks it out.
Looped up, on middle, Tom Latham goes down and makes it a full toss as he paddles it towards fine leg for a single.
Adam Zampa is back on. He conceded 7 runs in his first over.
In line with the stumps on a good length, Tom Latham gets across and flicks this towards deep square leg for a run and will keep strike.
Goes fuller this time and just outside off, Tom Latham blocks this back towards the bowler.
Pulls his length back a fraction and outside off, Kane Williamson looks to leave the ball but gets some bat on it to third man for a single.
This is on a good length as well and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson gets on top of the delivery and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Straying on the pads on a good length, Tom Latham flicks this past the square leg fielder and they take three runs.
Sean Abbott begins the over with a good length delivery outside off, Tom Latham guides this to the point fielder.
On a good length this time and outside off, Kane Williamson taps this towards backward point.
This is bowled full and outside off, Tom Latham taps this towards mid off with soft hands and takes a quick single.
Bowls this on a good length and angles it into the pads, Kane Williamson tucks this to fine leg for a single.
Goes back of a length this time and outside off, Kane Williamson uses the crease and punches the ball to cover.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson hits it hard back at the bowler and it hits his shin and goes towards cover.
This is on a good length and outside off, Kane Williamson shimmies down the wicket and blocks it back towards the bowler.
Sean Abbott ends with a full delivery outside off, Tom Latham pushes this towards mid off.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Kane Williamson guides this to third man for a single.
This is back of a length and outside off, Kane Williamson fends this into the pitch on the off side.

FOUR! Sean Abbott concedes on his 15th delivery and it is a boundary! He serves this on a good length and outside off, Kane Williamson gets on his toes and punches this through extra cover for a lovely boundary. Good timing in this shot as the fielders give chase but do not get to the ball.
On a good length and just outside off, Kane Williamson solid in defense as he taps this to the left of the bowler.
Sean Abbott begins the over with a good-length delivery in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson blocks this into the off side.
Cameron Green strays wide down leg side on a fuller length. Kane Williamson misses out as he gets too much bat on this and the ball goes towards the fine leg fielder for a single.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Tom Latham flicks this wide of mid on and takes a single to get off the mark.
This is on a good length as well and just outside off, Tom Latham taps this towards backward point.
Cameron Green serves this on a good length and gets this to angle away from the off stump after pitching on middle. Tom Latham judges this well and leaves it alone.
Tom Latham walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Cameron Green strikes and Australia have another wicket! Cameron Green serves a leg cutter in line with the stumps on a fuller length. Finn Allen looks to clip this leg side but is early into the shot. Lobs it into the air towards mid on where Josh Hazlewood comes running into take a low catch diving forward. New Zealand have lost both their openers and will need to rebuild.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Hazlewood b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Cameron Green pitches this outside leg on a good length, Kane Williamson clips this to deep backward square leg for a single
Keeps bowling on a good length and just outside off, Finn Allen knocks this towards mid on. Two maidens now for Sean Abbott and he continues doing what he did in the previous game.

Make that five! A huge appeal from the bowler. Sean Abbott bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Finn Allen gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball hits him high on the pads. The umpire remains unmoved.
Goes a touch wider outside off on a good length. Finn Allen dabs this into the off side and the point fielder comes running in to prevent a run. 4 dot balls in a row.
Continues bowling on a good length in the outside off stump channel, Finn Allen taps this towards mid off.
On a good length once again but this time outside the off stump. Finn Allen blocks this watchfully towards cover.
Sean Abbott begins the over with a good length delivery angled into the pads, Finn Allen clips the ball to the right of mid-wicket.
End of Powerplay 1. Australia will now place 4 fielders at the boundary till the 40th over.
Loopy and outside off, Kane Williamson drives it straight and the ball hits Allen on his boots.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Finn Allen forces it towards long on for a single.

SIX! That has been dispatched! Adam Zampa flights this one full and outside off, Finn Allen shimmies down the wicket and thumps this over long off for a biggie! Finn Allen is looking really good here and seems to be taking his opportunity.
Full once again and outside the off pole. Finn Allen taps this back towards the bowler.
Flights this full and outside off, Finn Allen knocks this towards mid off.
Shorter and outside off, Finn Allen stays back and cuts it towards backward point.
This is straight as well on a good length, Kane Williamson blocks this back towards the bowler. A maiden-wicket to start proceedings for Sean Abbott. He continues his good form with the ball.
Sean Abbott bowls this on a fuller length and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson looks to block and gets squared up as the ball hits the outside half of the bat and goes to point.
The skipper Kane Williamson makes his way out to the crease at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Sean Abbott stikes in his very first over and Australia gets the breakthrough. Abbott bowls this on good length and outside off, Devon Conway leans on to drive it but hits it uppishly towards point where Steven Smith takes a low catch diving forward. However, Conway is not sure but Smith is claiming it. The umpires sends it upstairs to check and the soft signal is Not Out. The first replay shows that the fingers are under the ball, but it is still not clear. The front on angle shows that the ball bounced up off his fingers as Smith complete the catch on the tumble. The umpire is satisfied and he says that it is Out and the on field decision is changed. This does not happen often when the soft signal is reversed, but this time it looks like the right call. Devon Conway is not happy with the decision, but he has to make the long walk back. New Zealand lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one and on middle, Devon Conway gets caught in his crease, but blocks it out well in the end.
Short and on off, Devon Conway pushes it off his back foot towards mid off.
Starts with a full delivery, on off, Devon Conway blocks it out.

FOUR! Three boundaries in the over for Allen in this over. Hazlewood serves this full and on middle, Finn Allen stays there and tucks it away nicely towards the deep mid-wicket fence for four runs. He did not try to hit it too hard, just placed it.
Goes fuller and on off, Finn Allen drives it to the right of mid off where Maxwell dives but only half-stops it. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Poor from Hazlewood and rightly punished. He lands this short and on the leg stump, sits up nicely for Allen as he pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence for another boundary.
This is on a good length and on off, Finn Allen pushes it towards covers.
On a length and on off, Finn Allen blocks it out.

FOUR! Allen gets into the act now. This is full and on middle, Finn Allen stays there and plays a nice on drive with the full face of the bat. The ball beats the mid on fielder and races away to the fence, We have seen some great on drives today.
Short of a length and outside off, nips back in, Devon Conway lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Wonderful shot! Green pitches it up, on middle, Devon Conway drives it firmly past the bowler where Green cannot get down in time, and the ball races away towards the wide long off fence for boundary.
Green with another good-length delivery, outside off, Devon Conway again offers no shot.
Length again, outside off, Devon Conway leans on and leaves it alone.
This is on a good length and on off, angling in, Devon Conway tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Conway welcomes Green with a boundary. This is short of a length and on middle, Devon Conway stays there and swivel pulls it thorugh mid-wicket for a boundary.
Cameron Green comes into the attack.
Another dot to end the over! This is full and on off, Finn Allen mistimes his drive towards mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and around off, Finn Allen looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Four dots in a row now!
Back of a length and on off, Finn Allen watches it through and blocks it down the pitch.
A bit fuller and on off, Finn Allen dabs it onto the ground and straight to backward point.
On a length and around off, Finn Allen pushes it towards point.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is full and on off, Finn Allen drives it towards cover where the fielder lets it through, Marnus Labuschagne gives chase, dives to push it back in but fails to stop the boundary.

FOUR! Some poor fielding to add to the poor bowling! Mitchell Starc bowls this on the pads once more on a fuller length and Devon Conway times this perfectly tpwards mid-wicket. The fielder gets a hand to the ball but does not stop it as the ball has enough legs on it to find the deep mid-wicket fence. 8 runs in the over with two boundaries.
Mitchell Starc goes outside off this time on a fuller length, Devon Conway drives this straight to mid off. He has found the fielders on quite a few occasions now.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Devon Conway knocks this towards the mid on fielder.
Straying into the pads once again on a fuller length. Devon Conway finds the mid-wicket fielder with his flick this time.
FOUR! Another poor delivery from Mitchell Starc! Strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Devon Conway helps himself to another boundary as he gets this towards fine leg for four more runs.
Mitchell Starc begins the over with good-length delivery nipping back into the left-hander. Devon Conway clips this to the right of square leg fielder who does well to save the single.
This is really straight and bowled on a fuller length. Finn Allen is watchful as he defends this back towards the bowler. Just one run from the over and New Zealand seem to be getting into a shell.
This is on a good length and angled into the stumps, Finn Allen blocks this solidly towards the mid on fielder.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off stump. Devon Conway charges down the wicket once again and works the ball past backward point for a single.
Josh Hazlewood changes the length and bowls this short outside off, Devon Conway goes to pull but does not connect.
Continues bowling on a good length but a touch closer to the stumps, Devon Conway shimmies down the wicket and taps the ball towards point.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and angling away from outside off, Devon Conway gets a confident stride forward and shoulders his arms to this.
Goes full this time and outside off, Finn Allen gets a stride forward and strokes the ball straight to mid off. 2 runs from this over.
Bowls this straight and on a good length, Finn Allen defends this to the right of the bowler.
Mitchell Starc bowling good lengths here and serves this just outside off, Finn Allen pushes at this and gets a thick outside edge towards point.
Continues bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen clips this to the left of square leg and takes a couple of runs.
This is angling away after pitching outside off on a good length. Finn Allen does not offer a shot this time.
Mitchell Starc serves this on a good length and outside the off pole, Finn Allen taps this towards cover.
Goes closer to the off stump this time on a good length, Devon Conway judges this well and raises his arms as he lets it through to the keeper.
Angles this one away from the left-hander from a good length. Devon Conway leaves this one alone.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this short and outside off, Finn Allen gets an under edge as he looks to pull this and takes a single as the ball goes to fine leg.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen blocks this back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Just the kind of luck you need to start your innings! Josh Hazlewood bowls this back of a length and outsidFinn Allen looks to pull this leg side but gets a top edge that goes to straightish third man for four runs. He gets his first boundary.
Josh Hazlewood begins on the money straight away as he serves this on a good length and outside off, Finn Allen taps this towards point.
Josh Hazlewood to share the attack with Mitchell Starc.

Beaten! Mitchell Santner finally gets it right as he serves this on a good length and just outside off. Devon Conway feels for it initially and draws his bat away as the ball zips past the bat. 7 runs from the first over and a good start for New Zealand.
Angles this into the pads on a fuller length, Devon Conway looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge towards mid on.
Delivers this on a fuller length and just outside off, Devon Conway knocks this straight to mid off.
FOUR! Devon Conway is off the mark with a boundary! Mitchell Starc goes full and strays well down leg side, Devon Conway gets bat on this and the ball tickles down to fine leg for four runs.
This is on a good length and angling down leg, Finn Allen tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Starc begins with a full delivery swinging into the stumps, Finn Allen times this well towards square leg and a misfield allows him to get off the mark with two runs.
